templates.why_chosen: A starred, high-confidence core pipeline exemplar: a depth-3 dashed Solver group nests two title-bar stages (Sequence Blaster, Parallelism Planner) before handing off to a separate solid Executor box, in 7 components and 4 flows.
templates.what_to_learn: Use a dashed box to group a multi-stage sub-pipeline as one unit distinct from the solid downstream stage, append section references directly onto stage titles, and use small coloured-bar card icons to encode variable-length data instead of prose.

templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence nested-stack exemplar at depth 3: a dashed Solver box contains two title-bar stages, and the inner Parallelism Planner itself contains a further Sequence Bucketing and Parallelism Solving pair, in just 7 components.
templates.what_to_learn: Make the outermost container a dashed logical grouping rather than a drawn system boundary, and change only the fill tint between nesting levels, dark-blue title bar to light-blue body, instead of also changing border style, keeping three levels of depth visually calm.
